biotools.summary: benchmarKIN is an R package enabling comprehensive evaluation of kinase activity inference methods by combining classical perturbation experiments with a tumor-based benchmarking approach utilizing multi-omics data. The tool helps researchers select reliable methods for identifying deregulated kinases.
